property_summary: The transfer function always returns true when it does not revert.
The transfer function returns true if and only if all internal calls succeed, as indicated by the bool return value of the low-level call.
The transfer function returns true if and only if all internal individual low-level calls succeed.
The transfer function returns true even when at least one internal call fails, but the reference returns false in that case.
The transfer function never reverts and always returns true, regardless of whether the internal low-level calls succeed or fail.
The transfer function returns the same boolean value as the last low-level call to the token contract succeeds (i.e., returns true) after the loop.
The transfer function returns false when contract_address equals address(this).
The transfer function must revert when the contract address equals address(this).
When contract_address equals address(this), reference returns true, but mutant reverts.
When contract_address equals address(this), the transfer function does not revert.
When contract_address equals address(this), the transfer function returns true without reverting.
The transfer function succeeds (returns true) only when the lengths of tos and vs arrays are equal.
